sections.Profile:
Play through the Jungle Event missions of the 1987 film as a Predator figure moves above the upper drop targets, working toward the El Cazador Trofeo de los Hombres wizard mode. Pinball Brothers' widebody has three flippers, a mini-gun ball shooter with a rotating muzzle, a motorized helicopter whose rotor blades drive the ball locks, and Alan Silvestri's movie theme running through the soundtrack.
